title: Multiplication compatibility forced by signed evaluation normalization
statement: Fix a finite purity setting P of [def-pur-conventions], a natural number n with P.level=n+1, the finite coefficient ring A=O_E/(varpi_E^(n+1)), and a proof that ell^(n+1) annihilates A. For every k-scheme X with structure morphism a, write L_X(r) and M_X(r) for the signed etale and pro-etale A-module sheaves, and nu_X for site comparison, as defined in [def-pur-signed-twist-site-transport-data]. Let b_X(j):nu_X^*L_X(j) ≅ M_X(j), j≥0, satisfy the specified root-tensor normalization [lem-amb-finite-tate-site-descent]. Let q_X(r) be any family of signed comparison isomorphisms agreeing with b in nonnegative degrees and satisfying the actual evaluation equation of [def-pur-signed-twist-site-transport-data]. Fix ordered multiplication isomorphisms mu_X(r,s):M_X(r) tensor M_X(s) ≅ M_X(r+s), normalized on every signed line basis as in [def-sf-signed-line-product-normalization-data]. Then for every pair of integers r,s, q_X(r+s) carries the pulled canonical etale ordered product to mu_X(r,s) applied to the two q-images. This is an equality on all pairs of local etale sections and after every restriction to a pro-etale object over them. It asserts SignedSiteMultiplication and makes no geometric claim.

proof.text: Check multiplication on a cover trivializing $L_X$. Write $e_0=1$, $e_a=e^{\otimes a}$ for $a>0$, and $e_{-a}=e_a^\vee$. Write $f=q_{X,1}(e)$ and define $f_a$ in the same way. The fixed positive tensor comparisons and Step 2 give $q_{X,a}(e_a)=f_a$ for every integer $a$. The module associators, symmetries and unitors are induced by their sectionwise module maps [lem-pc-sheaf-modules-tensor-closed]. Hence each ordered multiplication sends $e_r\otimes e_s$ to $e_{r+s}$: for two positive exponents it concatenates tensors; for two negative exponents the tensor of functionals takes value $1$ on $e_{-r-s}$; for opposite signs it contracts $\min(|r|,|s|)$ basis/dual pairs, leaving the positive or dual excess, and for equal opposite exponents the value is $1$. Zero exponents use the unitors. The same calculation holds for the $f_a$. The normalized inverse-image tensor comparison sends pulled pure tensors to tensors of pulled sections [lem-pur-independent-inverse-image-tensor-comparison]. Thus both sides of the claimed multiplication equation send $e_r\otimes e_s$ to $f_{r+s}$, and by linearity they agree. Equality is local by uniqueness of gluing sections. A replacement $e\mapsto ue$ multiplies $e_a$ by $u^a$ for every signed $a$, and both routes by $u^{r+s}$, so the calculation is independent of the cover and basis.

theorem signedTwistProductCompatibility (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u}) (n : ℕ)
    (hlevel : P.level = n + 1)
    (hA : ((P.coefficients.l ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) : P.signedSiteCoefficient n) = 0)
    (b : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u}) (_a : X ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) (k : ℕ),
      (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (P.signedSiteCoefficient n)) X).obj
        (P.signedSiteEtale n hA X (k : ℤ)) ≅ P.signedSitePro n X (k : ℤ))
    (hb : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u}) (a : X ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) (k : ℕ),
      IsFiniteTateSiteComparison P.coefficients.l P.extension n X n hA k (b X a k))
    (q : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u}) (_a : X ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) (r : ℤ),
      (ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (P.signedSiteCoefficient n)) X).obj
        (P.signedSiteEtale n hA X r) ≅ P.signedSitePro n X r)
    (hq : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u}) (a : X ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) (k : ℕ),
      q X a k = b X a k)
    (he : P.SignedSiteEvaluation n hA q)
    (μ : P.SignedSiteProducts n)
    (hμ : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u}) (a : X ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)),
      SheafOfModules.SignedLineProductNormalized.{u + 1, u, u + 1}
        (R := integralCoefficientCommRingSheaf P.coefficients.l P.extension X n)
        (purTwistFiniteOne X P.coefficients.l P.extension n) (μ X a)) :
    P.SignedSiteMultiplication n hlevel hA μ q
